about_the_game:
Hypermarket Simulator is a cozy and immersive retail simulation game where you build, manage, and grow a massive shopping paradise that goes way beyond groceries.

Build the Ultimate One-Stop Shop

From electronics to sportswear, frozen food to home décor—design your dream hypermarket filled with everything under one roof. Customize the layout, choose your departments, and create a shopping experience your customers will love.

Master Inventory and Realism

Stock thousands of different products—but be smart! Frozen goods need to be stored properly or they'll go rancid and become unsellable. Organize your backroom storage, build custom stock areas, and manage your supply like a pro.

Embrace Automation

As your hypermarket grows, so does the chaos. Streamline your operations with self-checkout kiosks to handle crowds and keep customers happy. Invest wisely to balance speed and service quality.

Stock, Sell, and Strategize

Hand-pick what you sell, set prices, and track what’s flying off the shelves. Will you specialize in high-end electronics or become the go-to spot for home essentials? Your pricing strategy, shelf organization, and restocking speed will make or break your business.

Expand and Evolve

Start small, dream big. Use your profits to expand your floor space and unlock new product categories to keep your operation running smoothly. Turn your hypermarket into a retail empire with smart upgrades and customer-focused planning.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: i5 3550 / RYZEN 5 2500X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 2060 6Gb
  • DirectX: Version 11

short_description: Manage a full-scale hypermarket with departments for electronics, sportswear, home décor, and more. It’s retail super-sized.
